entities.title: Workflows
entities.summary: The GitHub Actions that test every pull request and check its database changes; nothing here deploys.
entities.purpose: Holds the workflows and their scripts: ci.yml validates the .dev diagrams and knowledge files and tests and builds each game a pull request changes; game.yml is the one game's test and build that ci.yml calls (its deploy input and wrangler deploy step are left over: nothing calls it with deploy true since deploy.yml was removed on 2026-11-23); migrations.yml is the Database migration check on pull requests. scripts/ lists the changed games (leaving .dev files out) and runs the migration gate; last-deployed.sh and the gate's deploy mode are left over from deploy.yml and nothing runs them.
boundaries: Each game's pipeline, as it applies to that game, is described in that game's .dev/pipeline.json; this folder's pipeline.json describes the workflows themselves and links to them.

Nothing here deploys: each game is deployed by hand with npm run deploy in its folder and a Cloudflare API token for the account. Production database migrations are applied by hand too, and whoever deploys checks docs/database-migrations.md first.
